items:
Take your family getaway to the next level at 'Isle be "SEA"ing You!', 2 of our beautiful townhouses are ready to welcome you! With a total of 5 bedrooms and 4.5 baths there's plenty of room for everyone. You're located right next to The Big Chill, Prominence's family-friendly outdoor entertainment, dining, and shopping area. When it's time to cool off enjoy access to 2 community pools or jump in the golf carts and cruise the easy mile to Deer Lake Beach. If slower is your speed, hop on one of the 8 provided bikes and pedal away.Here's how it works:
This is 2 townhomes in the same Triplex in the Prominence neighborhood on 30A.
- Unit A: "Seas the Day' features 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths.
- Unit C: "Isle be Back' features 2 bedrooms and 2 baths.
- Bonus - The community. Prominence is a gem! 2 Resort style pools, outdoor space, outdoor grills, easy access to the beach, and quick stroll to The Big Chill. The Big Chill is a great family gathering place: entertainment like movies and concerts on the green, restaurants, and outdoor space for the family to hang. Perfect for evenings after the beach.

Read on below for more on each unit ~

▶️Highlights for Unit A ~
- 6 passenger golf cart
- 4 complimentary bikes
- Open kitchen and dining concept: A spacious kitchen island with a gas range, seashell details, and a custom deep blue
finish – perfect for the whole family to gather while the chef works their magic.
- Morning coffee made easy: Start your day with our Keurig – complimentary coffee on us!
- Dining area: Enjoy meals with seating for 6, plus 3 additional seats at the kitchen island.
- Outdoor deck: Take in the 30A sunshine with an additional dining area for drinks or morning coffee al fresco. Choose between a table for 4 or high-top Adirondack chairs. Bonus: a grill is included!
- Living room: Let's get cozy! Features custom cabinetry with a built-in fireplace – a rare find in Prominence. After a beach day, relax on the large sectional with the fireplace on and enjoy a family movie night.

For Rest (Sleeps 7)
Primary bedroom: King bed with smart TV, ceiling fan with En suite bathroom, double vanity, and walk-in shower.
Guest room: Queen bed with smart tv, 'crabby' details, and plenty of storage for enjoying your stay. Shares full bathroom. Bunk room: Great for the kids! Twin over Double bunk bed with Smart TV as well. Shares full bathroom.
We can also provide a pack n play for your little one - just ask!

▶️Highlights for Unit C ~
- Brand new 6 seater golf cart with lithium-ion batteries, upgraded seats, and built-in speakers. This is sure to be a family hit!
- 4 Complimentary Bikes
- Family Friendly – pack n play and highchair available for you!
- Large, open fully equipped kitchen
- Complimentary coffee – plus a standard coffee maker and Keurig as well!
- Dining area for 4, plus 3 additional seats at the kitchen island
- Rocking chairs on the deck – perfect morning coffee spot!

For Rest > (Sleeps 4)
King bedroom – En Suite, plenty of storage and Smart TV
Queen bedroom – Deck access, storage, and access to full bath

Included in your stay for BOTH units ~
- Starter kit for everything you'll need: paper towels, toilet paper, linens, towels, dish soap, laundry pods, etc.
- All bathrooms come fully equipped with Public Goods body wash, shampoo, and conditioner
- 2 Pools! Resort-style with zero entry that is also seasonally heated resort-style pool (Oct/Nov, Dec 17 - Jan 1, Mar/April), plus a secondary pool featuring cabanas and loungers.
- Full-size washer/dryer for your convenience.
- Parking for 1 in the garage, and 3 in the driveway.
- Grill and dining area at the community pool
- Complimentary beach chairs, cooler, beach towels, and pool toys
- ⭐️ NEW! ⭐️ Exclusive perk for Kalos' guests: Enjoy 20% off all Sculpt Studio classes at The Big Chill. Contact us for details!

▶️The good stuff: Beach Access! There are a lot of options when in Prominence.
- Deer Lake State Park Beach Access: Closest to Prominence! It is under a 5-minute golf cart ride or bike ride West on 30A from Prominence. This beach access has 50 parking spots available along with bathrooms and dining pavilions equipped with charcoal grills. The boardwalk here is lengthy (about a quarter mile), There is a $3 entry fee per vehicle that can be paid with cash on site or can also be reserved in advance.

- Gulf Lakes Beach Access: Best for bike rides to the beach and is a 7 minute ride East on the pedestrian path on the South side of 30A. There are newly placed "No Parking" signs on the South shoulder that prohibit parking golf carts on the South shoulder directly next to the Gulf Lakes Access and Pelican Circle community all the way to Camp Creek Lake.

- Seabreeze Beach Access: Right past Gulf Lakes Access and is another option with available North side 30A shoulder parking slightly closer to its entry. You can park and use the nearby crosswalk to crossover 30A directly to the access entry.

- Walton Dunes Beach Access: 10 min. golf cart ride West on 30A from Prominence. If you don't feel like paying the $3 at Deer Lake, then this is our favorite beach. This access is tucked in a residential area off 30A but has a public parking lot about 100 yards from the access entry. Walton Dunes is an easier entry as it has no boardwalk or steps, and you can walk from the road directly onto the beach. This is a good option for dropping off passengers and gear then parking in the nearby lot. The parking lot is limited, so getting here early is suggested. There are plenty of bicycle racks at the access should you decide to ride a bike.

- Inlet Beach Regional Access: 15-minute car ride but is a great option with ample parking, on-duty Lifeguards, and restrooms. You cannot take the golf cart to the Inlet Beach Access due to the distance from the house and because carts are restricted in Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and along Highway 98.

Other things to note:
- Parking is available in the driveway for 2 vehicles at the townhome directly in front of the garage door (unit A), plus one space in the garage. Unit C offers parking for 1 vehicle in the driveway directly in front of townhome garage door (Unit C). There is no street parking available but there is overflow parking in South Prominence.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 25.
- Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn't happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi or construction on 30A. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

Consider Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel. Kayaking, snorkeling, and parasailing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking nearby.
